---
name: Amendment proposal
about: Propose a normative change to the specification or schemas
labels: amendment, needs-discussion
---

**Problem** — what the current spec gets wrong or cannot express. Concrete
records beat prose; attach one if you can.

**Smallest normative change** — the minimal wording/schema diff that fixes it.

**Before/after record** — at least one example that validates differently
under your proposal, with both validator outputs.

**Blast radius** — additive (minor) or breaking (major)? Which levels of the
ladder are affected? Does it relax any MUST? (Relaxations get extra scrutiny.)
